content: TAL2, also referred to as T-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia 2, is a protein in humans that is encoded by the TAL2 gene. The TAL2 protein belongs to the basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) family of transcription factors, which are proteins that play a critical role in regulating gene expression by binding to specific DNA sequences. Alterations specific to tumors in the TAL2 gene have been identified in certain patients diagnosed with T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL), a type of aggressive blood cancer that affects T-lymphocytes.
